Once again the camp is for all bikers, riders and guys on bikes who can take a bit of advice and like learning new things. From the perspective of riders and racers, we'll teach you what and how to train and what to focus on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles, small drops and semi-legal trails in the area. From this year we're e-bike friendly – if your e-bike is suitable for off-road riding, you can sign up with it too.

LOCATION:

This year we have more training locations available. The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something on the pump track, in the skills centre and on the benches. On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have benches ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling.

In nearby Říčany we helped build a small trail, including several jumps and a drop-in from a tower.

There are also plenty of forest spots nearby for practising technique on roots or trails. For the braver ones there are doubles and drops, or root sections and real Enduro.

You can also get to the park where we start by train, from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Men and boys aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents. If we split into groups, they will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders. Advanced riders are welcome too – everyone can have a weak spot in their technique they want to practise.

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. Availability is shown as text, with details on request. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
